fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description: Detects command line containing reference to the "::$index_allocation" stream, which can be used as a technique to prevent access to folders or files from tooling such as "explorer.exe" or "powershell.exe"
fields.name: Potential Hidden Directory Creation Via NTFS INDEX_ALLOCATION Stream - CLI
fields.query: event.type="Process Creation" and (endpoint.os="windows" and tgt.process.cmdline contains "::$index_allocation")
